answer: Locks are recorded in tide, expire in shale, and terrace lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 140 aliases as a result needs 106 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 116 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
